verdict.rationale: Hands-on reports show the rcli runtime can be installed through Homebrew, a standard package manager, and that the install script itself pulls in Homebrew. However, one user reported that not everything loads properly when installed via Homebrew, and the pack contains no first-party install docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation of package-manager installation (Homebrew/SPM/Gradle/npm), evidence the install is quick and works reliably, coverage of the mobile SDK bindings via their native package managers.
